grammar_title: -ing/-ed 形式与不定式综合运用(非谓语动词复习)
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 2 Grammar in Use: -ing/-ed forms and infinitives (review)。句子地道、贸易经济主题、答案唯一(选项为同一动词的四种形式,只一个成立)。

points.point: 动词后接动名词还是不定式作宾语
points.overview: 有些动词后只接动名词(enjoy/finish/avoid/suggest/consider/mind/practise/keep/admit/give up 等),有些只接不定式(decide/hope/agree/offer/refuse/manage/plan/promise/afford/expect 等);按动词搭配在 -ing 和 to do 之间选择。

points.point: -ing 与 -ed 分词作定语/状语
points.overview: -ing 分词表主动或正在进行(修饰发出动作的名词,或主语主动发出动作);-ed 分词表被动或已完成(修饰承受动作的名词,或主语被动);据主动/被动关系选 -ing 或 -ed。

points.point: 不定式表目的/结果及固定结构
points.overview: to do 表目的(in order to / the way·first·best…to)或结果(too…to / enough to);adj.+to do、be likely/ready/willing/able to 等结构后只能用不定式,不可用 -ing/-ed。

questions.stem: The two companies finally finished ____ the trade agreement.
questions.explanation: finish 后只接动名词 → signing。

questions.stem: Many small firms avoid ____ too much money from banks.
questions.explanation: avoid 后只接动名词 → borrowing。

questions.stem: The manager suggested ____ costs before raising any prices.
questions.explanation: suggest 后接动名词 → cutting。

questions.stem: To stay competitive, we should keep ____ in new technology.
questions.explanation: keep(继续)后接动名词 → investing。

questions.stem: The factory considered ____ its production to a cheaper region.
questions.explanation: consider 后接动名词 → moving。

questions.stem: Many customers enjoy ____ online because it saves them time.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后只接动名词 → shopping。

questions.stem: He honestly admitted ____ a poor decision about the budget.
questions.explanation: admit 后接动名词 → making。

questions.stem: The shop owner did not mind ____ the price a little for us.
questions.explanation: mind 后接动名词 → lowering。

questions.stem: In class we practised ____ costs and benefits before each choice.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词 → comparing。

questions.stem: Once prices rose, many shoppers gave up ____ luxury goods.
questions.explanation: give up 后接动名词 → buying。

questions.stem: In 2014, the government decided ____ the free trade zone.
questions.explanation: decide 后只接不定式 → to expand。

questions.stem: The company hopes ____ the overseas market early next year.
questions.explanation: hope 后接不定式 → to enter。

questions.stem: After long talks, both sides agreed ____ the price of the goods.
questions.explanation: agree 后接不定式 → to reduce。

questions.stem: She kindly offered ____ her friend some money for the trip.
questions.explanation: offer 后接不定式 → to lend。

questions.stem: The young trader refused ____ at such an unfair price.
questions.explanation: refuse 后接不定式 → to sell。

questions.stem: After months of talks, they managed ____ a fair deal at last.
questions.explanation: manage 后接不定式 → to reach。

questions.stem: Our class plans ____ a small fund for the spring outing.
questions.explanation: plan 后接不定式 → to raise。

questions.stem: He promised ____ back the loan within a single year.
questions.explanation: promise 后接不定式 → to pay。

questions.stem: Few families can afford ____ money on things they do not need.
questions.explanation: afford 后接不定式 → to waste。

questions.stem: The seller expects buyers ____ prices carefully before paying.
questions.explanation: expect sb 后接不定式 → to compare。

questions.stem: China has become a ____ engine for the whole world economy.
questions.explanation: engine 主动地'增长' → 现在分词 growing。

questions.stem: Shoppers like cheap products ____ from other countries.
questions.explanation: products 被进口、被动 → 过去分词 imported。

questions.stem: A well-____ brand can sell its goods at higher prices.
questions.explanation: brand 被知晓、被动 → 过去分词 known。

questions.stem: The ____ goods were loaded onto the ship at the busy port.
questions.explanation: goods 被打包、被动 → 过去分词 packed。

questions.stem: Cross-border trade has opened an ever-____ market for sellers.
questions.explanation: market 主动地'扩大' → 现在分词 expanding。

questions.stem: Careful buyers trust ____ goods that pass strict quality tests.
questions.explanation: goods 被生产、被动 → 过去分词 manufactured。

questions.stem: The ____ cost of oil worried many small businesses last year.
questions.explanation: cost 主动地'上涨' → 现在分词 rising。

questions.stem: Before the trip, we compared the prices of three ____ flights.
questions.explanation: flights 主动地'相互竞争' → 现在分词 competing。

questions.stem: The manager read the ____ report carefully before the meeting.
questions.explanation: report 被打印、被动 → 过去分词 printed。

questions.stem: An economy ____ by innovation usually grows much faster.
questions.explanation: economy 被创新推动、被动 → 过去分词 driven。

questions.stem: The goods ____ in this region are both cheap and reliable.
questions.explanation: goods 被生产、被动 → 过去分词 produced。

questions.stem: The free trade zone, ____ in 2013, lies in the Pudong area.
questions.explanation: zone 被建立、被动 → 过去分词 founded。

questions.stem: Companies ____ reasonable decisions always weigh costs and benefits.
questions.explanation: companies 主动'作出'决定 → 现在分词 making。

questions.stem: The money ____ in the bank can later be loaned to others.
questions.explanation: money 被存、被动 → 过去分词 saved。

questions.stem: The students ____ the trading game learned a lot about money.
questions.explanation: students 主动'玩'游戏 → 现在分词 playing。

questions.stem: A plan ____ to cut waste was warmly welcomed by the board.
questions.explanation: plan 被设计、被动 → 过去分词 designed。

questions.stem: ____ the costs and benefits, the family made a wise choice.
questions.explanation: family 主动比较(带宾语)、作状语 → 现在分词 Comparing。

questions.stem: ____ by clever managers, the firm soon began to make a profit.
questions.explanation: firm 被带领、被动状语 → 过去分词 Led。

questions.stem: The shoppers left the market, ____ bags full of cheap goods.
questions.explanation: shoppers 主动'提着'、伴随状语 → 现在分词 carrying。

questions.stem: ____ by the good news, investors put more money into the firm.
questions.explanation: investors 被鼓舞、被动状语 → 过去分词 Encouraged。

questions.stem: The luxury watch was far too expensive ____ easily.
questions.explanation: too…to 结构 → 不定式 to sell。

questions.stem: These simple products are cheap enough ____ many buyers.
questions.explanation: enough to 结构 → 不定式 to attract。

questions.stem: Oil grew so scarce that it was too costly ____ at all.
questions.explanation: too…to 结构 → 不定式 to waste。

questions.stem: The young company was strong enough ____ foreign markets.
questions.explanation: enough to 结构 → 不定式 to enter。

questions.stem: The best way ____ costs is to plan a careful budget.
questions.explanation: the best way to do 固定结构 → 不定式 to cut。

questions.stem: Saving a little each day is the first step ____ towards wealth.
questions.explanation: the first step to do → 不定式 to take。

questions.stem: It takes time and trust ____ a lasting trade partnership.
questions.explanation: It takes…to do 结构 → 不定式 to build。

questions.stem: That honest trader was the first ____ a fair price for the goods.
questions.explanation: the first to do → 不定式 to offer。

questions.stem: Cheap imported products are likely ____ from the shelves quickly.
questions.explanation: be likely to do → 不定式 to disappear。

questions.stem: A rational buyer is always willing ____ costs and benefits.
questions.explanation: be willing to do → 不定式 to compare。

questions.stem: The two firms are now ready ____ the new trade agreement.
questions.explanation: be ready to do → 不定式 to sign。

questions.stem: In order ____ money, the family made a careful spending plan.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的 → 不定式 to save。

questions.stem: The new policy is likely ____ the local economy this year.
questions.explanation: be likely to do → 不定式 to boost。

questions.stem: The market was too crowded for the small shop ____ for long.
questions.explanation: too…for sb to do → 不定式 to survive。

questions.stem: She was very happy ____ cheaper goods at the morning market.
questions.explanation: adj.(happy)+ to do → 不定式 to find。

questions.stem: The only way ____ loyal customers is to offer real value.
questions.explanation: the only way to do → 不定式 to win。

questions.stem: The struggling firm needs more time ____ its huge debt.
questions.explanation: time to do → 不定式 to repay。

questions.stem: Wise families are careful enough ____ running up large debts.
questions.explanation: enough to do → 不定式 to avoid。

questions.stem: It is never too late ____ how to manage your own money.
questions.explanation: too…to 结构 → 不定式 to learn。

questions.stem: The manager was glad ____ a fair deal with the friendly buyer.
questions.explanation: adj.(glad)+ to do → 不定式 to reach。
